assets.note: Favicons, app icons, manifest.json and browserconfig.xml.
Cinzel Decorative (display) and Inclusive Sans (body), with their OFL licence texts.
The colour palette. src/lib/styles/tokens.css aliases these rather than restating the hexes; colors.json is the machine-readable twin and nothing in the app reads it.
Lockups for the landing page hero. It uses the two -green variants; the rest arrive because the sync copies a directory whole, and pruning them would make --check report them missing forever.

The landing page is a separate bucket and cannot reach the app's copy, so it takes its own. Only InclusiveSans-Variable.woff2 is referenced; see docs/landing-page.md for why Cinzel and the italic are not.
Same reason as the fonts. The landing page uses the --ia-* names directly rather than aliasing them, having no vocabulary of its own to preserve.
